obligations.requirement: BrushDefinition and capability profiles are deterministic, renderer-neutral, platform-neutral runtime models with explicit validation.
obligations.oracle: Table-driven construction, normalization, versioning and rejection tests across every V1 brush family and capability combination.
obligations.acceptance: Equivalent definitions normalize identically; unsupported versions, invalid ranges and unavailable required capabilities fail explicitly; no renderer, GPU or platform handle enters the model.

obligations.requirement: BrushProgram is immutable, versioned, renderer-neutral IR with stable identity and compiler rejection for unsupported capability requirements.
obligations.oracle: Independent fixture-to-program snapshots, stable identity/digest tests and negative compiler fixtures.
obligations.acceptance: The same definition and capability profile produce the same program identity and structure; unsupported or malformed programs cannot execute.

obligations.requirement: BrushRuntime is the single semantic evaluator and emits isolated incremental commit and preview artifacts for keyed sessions.
obligations.oracle: Deterministic multi-session replay, chunk-boundary equivalence, commit/preview separation and cancellation tests.
obligations.acceptance: Incremental and one-shot evaluation are equivalent; cancellation removes only the keyed transient session; preview state cannot mutate canonical state.

obligations.requirement: Shape and grain resources use stable ResourceId bindings with explicit missing-resource behavior and no canonical GPU handles.
obligations.oracle: Known, missing, mismatched and unavailable-resource fixtures evaluated independently of the renderer.
obligations.acceptance: Every resource reference resolves deterministically or returns an explicit failure/degraded status permitted by the frozen profile; GPU and backend handles never enter canonical records.

obligations.requirement: Dynamics and random channels are deterministic and domain-separated by stable seed/channel/sample identity.
obligations.oracle: Golden numeric sequences, channel-independence tests, replay on supported host toolchains and existing TexturedMarker v1 goldens.
obligations.acceptance: Equal inputs reproduce equal output; adding or consuming one channel does not perturb another; TexturedMarker v1 remains byte/structure compatible under its existing oracle.

obligations.requirement: Pen, Pencil, Chalk, Marker, Water Color Lite and Highlighter persistent experiences compile and evaluate through the common pipeline.
obligations.oracle: Per-family structural program snapshots, deterministic runtime fixtures and independently frozen visual/golden corpus.
obligations.acceptance: All six persistent families satisfy their frozen representation and output invariants without platform-specific semantic forks.

obligations.requirement: Laser uses Arc temporal transient presentation, has monotonic release/fade/expiry and performs zero canonical mutation.
obligations.oracle: Fake-clock lifecycle tests, transient snapshot sequences and before/after canonical document digest comparison.
obligations.acceptance: Lifecycle is deterministic and monotonic; expiry removes the transient; canonical document digest and operation history are unchanged.

obligations.requirement: Brush Lab can exercise definitions, programs, runtime artifacts and visual corpus while emitting qualification and G5 workload counters.
obligations.oracle: Headless Brush Lab scenarios plus manifest completeness and artifact hash validation.
obligations.acceptance: Every V1 family and Laser has a reproducible scenario, expected artifact and workload record bound to the exact result revision.

obligations.requirement: G4/G4.4 interaction behavior and historical FinePen, Highlighter and TexturedMarker replay/goldens remain unchanged.
obligations.oracle: Existing G4/G4.4 test suites, semantic wire/golden corpus and repository diff/scope audit.
obligations.acceptance: All related tests pass with no canonical schema, ObjectKind, Operation, lock-file or historical evidence rewrite.

obligations.requirement: Windows, Web and Android qualification builds and self-contained evidence bundles are ready for one unified physical checkpoint.
obligations.oracle: Qualification manifest validates build identity, capability profile, scenario inventory, expected observations and artifact hashes.
obligations.acceptance: All three platform profiles are represented; unsupported pen pressure or tilt is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE or NOT_EXERCISED rather than failed or promoted to PASS.

obligations.requirement: G4.5-10 performs capability-profiled Tier-A physical qualification, freezes the G5 workload and issues the final Gate report.
obligations.oracle: Reviewer-accessible G4.5-10 physical observations and exact-build qualification evidence.
obligations.acceptance: Required scenarios pass on the available device profiles; pressure and tilt checks are required only on supporting profiles; G4.5 PASS is issued only by independent CONTROL_REVIEW.
